title: Downloads & Saved Items Rework
notes: Improved: "Downloads" is now part of Saved Items — no separate menu entry on either portal
Improved: files you download are kept as thumbnails + links (not heavy copies), redirecting to the content page to re-download
Improved: purchased content now appears in Saved Items under a new Purchases tab, grouped by category
Improved: single content pages still have their Download button — the file downloads straight from the live content, nothing is copied into your browser storage
